# @three-ws/glb-tools

> Inspect, re-theme, and bake GLB models from the shell or CI. The client SDK behind the three.ws 3D asset pipeline — structural inspection, token-themed mesh synthesis, and appearance baking over live three.ws endpoints.

@three-ws/glb-tools is a JavaScript library from three.ws. Install: `npm install @three-ws/glb-tools`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/glb-tools/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, full reference
- [Documentation site](https://nirholas.github.io/glb-tools/): the README as a web page
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/glb-tools/llms-full.txt): README inlined
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/glb-tools/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
